de.my_domain.abalone.model

Class Ball

  • java.lang.Object
    • de.my_domain.abalone.model.Ball
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable

    public class Ball
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Cloneable
    The Ball Wrapper Class. Ball is a Wrapper Class for the enum types Color and Player. It also saves a coordinate so that a ball can be clearly assigned to a slot on the board of a Game. The class provides methods to make it possible to get its color, as its owner and its current position. It als provides setter to change the latter and thus move the object.

    • Constructor Detail

      • Ball

        public Ball(Color color,
            Player owner,
            int row,
            int diag)
        The Ball constructor returns a new Ball object and sets its parameters as given by the following parameters.
        Parameters:
        color - Is the color of the ball, represented by an object of the enum Color.
        owner - Is the owner or rather player which owns the returned ball, given by an object of the enum Player.
        row - Is the current row coordinate of the object.
        diag - Is the current diagonal coordinate of the object.

      • moveCoordinates

        public void moveCoordinates(Direction dir)
        The moveCoordinates method is a special setter method for both, the row and the diagonal coordinates. It only takes a direction in which this object should be moved and changes its coordinates respectively.
        Parameters:
        dir - Is the direction in which the ball needs to move as an enum Direction.

      • isHuman

        public boolean isHuman()
        The isHuman method is a query method, which is called when one wants to know if a ball has an owner and whether the ball's owner is human or not.
        Returns:
        true if the ball has an owner an it is Player.HUMAN. false if the ball does not have an owner or if the owner is Player.MACHINE.

      • isMachine

        public boolean isMachine()
        The isMachine method is a query method, which is called when one wants to know if a ball has an owner and whether the ball's owner is machine or not.
        Returns:
        true if the ball has an owner an it is Player.MACHINE. false if the ball does not have an owner or if the owner is Player.HUMAN.

      • isEmpty

        public boolean isEmpty()
        The isEmpty method is a query method, which is called when one wants to know if a ball has a color or solely is a placeholder for an empty slot.
        Returns:
        true if the ball is a placeholder and thus is color is Color.EMPTY false if the ball is not a placeholder and thus has a color and belongs to an owner.
